Profile Cloricromen is an antiplatelet drug with vasodilating activity and is used in thromboembolic disorders (p.1187). It is given as the hydrochloride in arterial vascular disorders where there is a risk of thrombosis. It may be given orally in a dose of 100 mg two or three times daily or intravenously in a dose of 30 mg daily. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Ital.: Proendotel.
